newsitem.title: GREECE: FORECAST - Greek Dec inflation seen at 7.5pct y/y. [corrected 11:44 gmt]
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Greek Dec inflation seen at 7.5pct y/y. [corrected 11:44 gmt]

text.p: Greek consumer price inflation for December 1996 will fall to 7.5 percent year-on-year from 7.7 percent in November, bankers and economists predicted in an informal poll conducted by Reuters.
Fifteeen bankers and economists participated in the poll which produced a mean forecast of 7.5 percent for the December figure. Forecasts ranged from 7.6 percent to 7.4 percent.
The official CPI inflation figure will be released on Wednesday (Corrects from Tuesday), a National Statistics Service (NSS) official told Reuters.
